subject.title: feat(android): keep realtime Talk inside Chat

question: Should Android retire the separate Voice destination and make Chat the sole user-visible host for realtime Talk and its setup state?
rationale: This is a deliberate navigation and interaction-model change rather than a narrowly established bug fix, and the stacked branch makes it important to confirm the intended Android product boundary before merge.

options.title: Adopt Chat-hosted Talk
options.body: Approve Chat as the sole visible Talk surface, then require final-head regression proof for configured Talk, setup-needed Talk, legacy Voice routing, and Back behavior.

options.title: Keep Voice as a destination
options.body: Retain the existing visible Voice destination and limit any composer work to launching that established surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt Chat-hosted Talk
recommendation.body: Approve Chat as the sole visible Talk surface, then require final-head regression proof for configured Talk, setup-needed Talk, legacy Voice routing, and Back behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied stack history connects this contributor to the microphone/session behavior that the product decision affects, though current-main ownership verification remains unavailable.
